purpose: Teach: 玲子/聖子/茜/秀雄/浅田/川端/吉本/細田

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「玲子おばさんは料理上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad was saying Reiko-aunt is really skilled in the kitchen.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Gentle smile beneath the words. Noticing something tender about him without making a show of it. Warm, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと松田聖子のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis—I watched a documentary about Matsushita Seiko with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm. Eager to share something small that felt important. Slight pitch lift on the memory. Unguarded, child-simple honesty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「茜ちゃんは絵が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad mentioned Akane is quite talented with drawing.
lines.style: Same gentle cadence as before. A quiet thread of noticing—how he speaks about people he cares for. Warm without needing to explain why.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと秀雄おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis—I went to meet Uncle Hideo with Dad today.
lines.style: Same eager brightness. Direct, simple pride in the experience. Bouncing slightly under the surface. Wants her to know it mattered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが浅田真央さんの伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad is reading a biography of Asada Mao right now.
lines.style: Continuing the gentle thread. Each observation building a small picture of him. Tender without sentimentality. The warmth of noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと川端康成の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis—Dad and I read a picture book by Kawabata Yasunari together.
lines.style: Unfiltered joy in the retelling. Simple, immediate, no self-consciousness. The brightness of a child sharing something real that happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「吉本興業の漫才は奥が深い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad was saying the comedy sketches from Yoshimoto Kogyo have real depth to them.
lines.style: The gentlest observation yet. A lingering quality—almost a small laugh at the thought of him. Warm recognition of something specific about who he is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと細田守監督のサマーウォーズ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis—Dad and I watched Summer Wars by director Hosoda Mamoru.
lines.style: Peak brightness and directness. No hesitation, no filtering. Pure, unguarded delight in sharing the moment. Simple, vivid memory held up to the light.
